paragraphs: R' Perata: see Rabbi Elazar ben Perata.[^1]

notes.text: The checked Pesachim 119b and Nedarim 41a paragraphs fully title Rabbi Elazar ben Perata and Rabbi Yose ben Perata. The checked Chullin 98a chain has Levi bar Perata without a title; R’ Levi preserves Hyman’s abbreviated title without adding a full Rabbi from that witness. The standalone R’ Perata pointer is kept separate from the named Elazar attestation. These notices do not identify one common father or merge the figures.
